name: filipino-lang-explorer
description: Interactive vocabulary, history timeline, and quiz app for learning Filipino words and the culture behind them.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
